capabilities: Sync clippings to extract summaries, key claims, and topics
Generate a Reading Synthesis report note with themes and weekly saves
Identify topics shared across two or more clippings
Flag clippings that have sat unread past a stale threshold
Connect to Anthropic, OpenAI, OpenRouter, or custom OpenAI-compatible endpoints
disambiguation: Not a web clipper or read-later app; it only synthesizes clippings already saved in the vault.
extras: Freemium: free tier allows 10 lifetime clipping syncs per vault; report generation is always free. Pro is a one-time purchase (no subscription or account) with offline license verification, sold via Gumroad. Clippings are sent only to the chosen AI provider; no servers or telemetry.
motivation: After Pocket shut down in 2025, users moved clippings into Obsidian via Web Clipper but the unread backlog moved with them, becoming a 'to-read graveyard' in the vault.
problem: Web clippings pile up unread in the vault, and Obsidian offers no way to process a large clipping backlog or see what has gone stale.

relations.evidence: Clip articles into Obsidian as you normally would (the official Web Clipper works out of the box)
